MHC Icon System — Contact Sheet

Every icon on the Figma Icons page, exported and deduped by shape signature. Click a tile to copy its key. Monochrome glyphs ship via mhc-icons.css and take their colour from currentColor; multicolour ones ship as SVG files with the palette baked in.

1 · Name collisions — pick one, retire the rest (43)

Same name in Figma, genuinely different artwork. The first of each pair holds the plain key; the others are suffixed -2, -3 so nothing silently wins. Identical duplicates were merged automatically and are not shown here.

2 · Broken scaling — rebuild required (36)

The icons8 imports. Their size variants are the same fixed-pixel artwork dropped into larger frames, so the glyph stays put while the padding grows. Renaming will not fix these — they need redrawing.
